title: SQL Practice: Window Functions and CTEs
oneLiner: Graded SQL problems: top N per group, running totals, month-over-month change, first order per customer, and the longest streak.
keyTakeaway: Rank inside groups with a window function in a CTE and filter outside it. Aggregate to the right grain first (per day, per month), then apply the window. Consecutive runs are grouped by date minus ROW_NUMBER.
explanation: Six graded problems that need window functions or CTEs, ending with the gaps-and-islands streak question that separates strong SQL candidates from the rest. Your query is compared with a reference answer on a fresh copy of the shop database.
